description: This PHP script implements OAuth2 client flow with Google API. It handles user authorization, token retrieval, user profile data fetching, and error handling related to Google OAuth2 authentication.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for Google, used to facilitate OAuth2 authorization flow.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Google provider, initializes with client ID, secret, redirect URI, and optional hosted domain.

methods.name: getAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect the user for OAuth2 authorization.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state parameter used for CSRF protection during OAuth flow.

methods.name: getResourceOwner
methods.description: Retrieves resource owner (user) details using an access token.
